stop_reason: Completed the preregistered three development rounds and one frozen final evaluation; no fourth round or test-driven checkpoint selection.
findings: Trained three PPO lineages locally for 1179648 total sampled decision steps; original flight environment and runtime controller were not changed.
Development mean loss improved from the original predictor baseline 0.3855380451 to 0.1062888656. All three development rounds were kept as checkpoints, not git commits.

Primary ppo_lineage33 was frozen using development loss before final test. Its selected checkpoint has 360448 model timesteps and SHA256 601aafbc2b1853236c85e84404caef134440718e1fcd78b36edc8a568f1b65d0.
Final evaluation contains 2376 paired rows: 6 methods over 256 held-out synthetic cases plus 7 previously seen nominal initial states and 133 stress regressions.

On synthetic holdout, primary PPO reduced reversals from 115/256 to 34/256 against predictive margin 0.08, but near-stationary cases fell from 32 to 21 and mean absolute tail speed rose from 0.0997 to 0.1219 m/s.

On seven nominal measured initial states, primary PPO had zero simulated reversals but zero near-stationary cases, leaving mean tail speed 0.1399 m/s. These are simulated rollouts from measured states, not new flights.
This is simulator-trained PPO, not fixed-dataset-only offline RL. It learns a binary braking-release time and has no final-position objective or position handoff model.

The main limitation is a reversal-versus-residual-motion tradeoff, with additional distribution mismatch in prior command histories and motion directions. More training on the same objective cannot be assumed to solve position stopping.
70 focused tests passed with optional RL dependencies. Related base-environment tests are recorded in verification.md. No deployment, SSH, flight, commit, or push was performed.

config.goal: Build and execute bounded local offline training for release braking, and report both improvements and failures.
config.scope: Independent RK4 simulator, Gymnasium environment, CPU PPO, frozen development/test populations, provenance and local artifacts only.
config.metric: Mean terminal loss on the 64 fixed development scenarios generated with seed 9001
